name: Jaiz
source: Jaiz Bank Plc Annual Report and Financial Statements 2023 (audited): statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income, page 62, and five-year financial summary, page 135; FY2025/FY2024 as previously recorded

derivation.formula: Profit Before Tax minus Profit after Tax
derivation.why: Jaiz Bank Annual Report 2025 page 56 prints Gross Earnings 102,812,858 and 82,874,821, profit before tax 31,247,090 and 24,444,875 and profit after tax 23,484,251 and 30,156,803 in N thousands. The tax and windfall levy lines do not extract cleanly from that page, so the charge is taken as profit before tax less profit after tax, which ties by construction. FY2024 is a credit because the printed profit after tax exceeded the printed profit before tax.

source_note: Jaiz Bank Annual Report 2025 page 56 prints Gross Earnings 102,812,858 and 82,874,821, profit before tax 31,247,090 and 24,444,875 and profit after tax 23,484,251 and 30,156,803 in N thousands. The tax and windfall levy lines do not extract cleanly from that page, so the charge is taken as profit before tax less profit after tax, which ties by construction. FY2024 is a credit because the printed profit after tax exceeded the printed profit before tax. The stored Income Tax row held 102,812,858,000 and 82,874,821,000, which are the printed Gross Earnings figures, and 30,156,803,000, which is the printed profit after tax for FY2024, so those three cells were evicted rather than kept.
